title: Backups
subtitle: Backup and restore the whole system. Covers every branch.
passphraseDesc_set: A passphrase is set. Every backup is encrypted with it.
passphraseDesc_missing: No passphrase yet. Backups are off until you set one.
passphraseDesc_unreadable: This server cannot read the saved passphrase. Type it again to continue.
passphraseWarning: Keep this passphrase safe. Without it no backup can ever be opened, and nobody — not even us — can recover it.
scheduleDesc: Make a backup automatically every day.
runPartlyFailed: Backup done, but a place failed. See the list.
placeDesc_LOCAL: A folder on the shop's own server.
placeDesc_TELEGRAM: Sends the encrypted file to a Telegram chat in parts.
placeDesc_GOOGLE_DRIVE: Uploads to a private folder in your Google Drive.
placeDesc_ONEDRIVE: Uploads to the app's folder in Microsoft OneDrive.
telegramNote: Use a private chat or channel just for backups, not the staff group. Old backups cannot be deleted from Telegram.
redirectNote: Register this exact address with Google or Microsoft as the redirect URI.
connectNeedsClient: Set the client ID and secret first.
deleteConfirm: The backup from {date} will be removed. This cannot be undone.
restoreWarning: This replaces the whole database and all pictures. Everything since this backup will be lost, and everyone will be signed out.
restoreShopNameLabel: Type your shop name to confirm
uploadDesc: Choose a .mbk backup file from your computer.
overlayRestoringBody: The system is restoring a backup. Do not close this window. It will come back by itself.
overlayManualBody: The restore could not finish and could not be rolled back. Call whoever installed the system before doing anything else.
overlayDoneBody: The restore is done and every session was ended. Please sign in again.
overlayWipingBody: The system is erasing the shop's data. Do not close this window. It will come back by itself.
overlayWipeDoneBody: The shop's data was erased and every session was ended. A safety backup was made first. Please sign in again.
overlayResettingBody: The system is performing a factory reset. Do not close this window.
overlayResetDoneBody: The system has been reset to its first-boot state. Please proceed to setup.
dangerZoneDesc: Erase the shop's data to start fresh. A safety backup is made first.
factoryResetDesc: Erase everything: all data, accounts, branches, settings and secrets. Returns the system to first-boot setup.
resetDialogWarning: This permanently erases all accounts, branches, settings and data. A safety backup is made first.
resetPlainWordsTitle: Before you continue, understand what happens:
resetPointAccounts: Every user account, branch, setting and connection is erased
resetPointSafety: A safety backup is made and verified first
resetPointSetupCode: Afterwards the system asks for the setup code from the server's log
resetPointPhoneApps: All phone apps and browsers are signed out
resetUnderstandLabel: I understand that all accounts, branches and settings will be permanently erased
wipeWarning: This erases all sales, stock, money and other records. It cannot be undone from here — only by restoring the safety backup made first.
wipeAlways: All sales, stock, money, repairs and quality checks
wipeContactsLabel: Also erase customers, partners and suppliers
wipeCatalogLabel: Also erase the product catalogue (products, prices, pictures)
wipeKept: User accounts, branches, all settings, the backups, and the system lists and phone references.
wipeSafetyNote: A safety backup is made first. To undo an erase, restore that backup from the list above.
wipeUnderstandLabel: I understand this cannot be undone from here
wipeErrRunning: A backup, restore or erase is already running. Try again when it finishes.
wipeErrNoPassphrase: Set the backup passphrase first (see Encryption passphrase above) so a safety backup can be made.
wipeErrSafetyBackup: The safety backup could not be made or opened, so nothing was erased. Check the Backups above and try again.
errRunning: A backup is already running. Try again when it finishes.
errPassphraseUnreadable: This server cannot read the passphrase. Set it again.
errTooLarge: The database is too large to back up.
errFileMissing: The backup file is missing on the server.
errUploadNotFound: The uploaded file was not found. Upload it again.
errConfirmFailed: The shop name or password did not match.
errNewerVersion: This backup is from a newer version. Upgrade the server first.
errLocalLocked: The server disk cannot be switched off.
errChatIsStaffChat: This chat is used for staff alerts. Use a separate chat for backups.
errOauthNotSupported: This place does not use Connect.
errOauthReturnUrl: The return address is not allowed.
errTooManyTries: Too many tries. Wait a minute and try again.
